findText.lair: Take the caravan's strongbox back from the outlaws of {target}
findText.foe: Run down {target} and recover the caravan's strongbox

missing_caravan.returnText: Bring the strongbox back to {giver} in {town}
missing_caravan.handIn: *pries open the lid* It's all here. You've saved my season — here, as promised.

alt.label: Keep the strongbox ({gold} gold inside)
alt.text: You kept {giver}'s strongbox and its {gold} gold.
alt.grievance: I heard you found my strongbox — and kept it. Thief.

spice_supplier.deliverText: Carry the letter of terms to {person}, {role} of {target}
spice_supplier.recipientLine: *breaks the seal and reads* Terms from {giver}, is it? Tell them I'll deal — here is my answer.
spice_supplier.handIn: *reads the reply and grins* We have a bargain! You're a born go-between.

findText.lair: Clear out the outlaw lair of {target}
findText.foe: Break {target}, who camp in the woods nearby

bandit_camp.handIn: *lets out a long breath* Done? Truly? The captain will hear of this — and so will the town.

lost_report.fetchText: Ask {person} of {target}, who picked up a dropped report at the tavern
lost_report.returnText: Bring the patrol report back to {giver} in {town}
lost_report.holderLine: *fishes in a pocket* This? Found it under a bench. Thought it looked official — take it, I want no trouble.
lost_report.handIn: *snatches it and tucks it away* The captain need never know. I owe you, friend.

alt.label: Hand the report to the captain instead (40 gold reward)
alt.text: You turned {giver}'s lost report in to the captain.
alt.grievance: You gave that report to the captain. I was docked a month's pay.

findText.foe: Hunt down {target}, who have been killing the livestock

livestock_killer.returnText: Tell {giver} in {town} the beasts are dead
livestock_killer.handIn: *wipes eyes* No more dead lambs in the morning. Bless you, bless you.

missing_son.handIn: *throws arms around {person}* You brought them home! I'll never be able to repay you.

alt.label: Let {person} go
alt.text: {person} begged you not to take them back, and you let them go.
alt.grievance: You found my child and let them walk away? You should have brought them home.

stolen_relic.handIn: *kneels and kisses the relic* It is home. The faithful will sing your name tonight.

alt.label: Sell the relic to a collector ({gold} gold)
alt.text: You sold the shrine's relic for {gold} gold.
alt.grievance: The relic was sold — and by you. The gods see everything.

findText.site: Lay the dead to rest in {target}

restless_dead.returnText: Tell {giver} in {town} the graves are quiet
restless_dead.handIn: *makes the holy sign* The graves are quiet. Our people may visit their dead again.

rare_ore.handIn: *turns the ore in the firelight* Now THAT is metal. I'll make you something worthy of it.

findText.foe: Track down {target}, who stole the knight's sword

stolen_sword.returnText: Bring the sword back to {giver} in {town}
stolen_sword.handIn: *runs a thumb down the edge* Not a nick on it. My name is saved — and you have a friend at this forge.

alt.label: Keep the sword for yourself
alt.grievance: You've the knight's sword on your hip, I hear. My sword. My name.

findText.lair: Take the locket back from the outlaws of {target}
findText.foe: Run down {target} and take the locket back

lost_locket.returnText: Bring the locket back to {giver} in {town}
lost_locket.handIn: *clutches the locket to their chest* Oh... it's really her locket. Thank you. Thank you.

alt.label: Sell the locket to a fence ({gold} gold)
alt.text: You sold {giver}'s grandmother's locket for {gold} gold.
alt.grievance: They say you sold my grandmother's locket to a fence. How could you?

hermit_medicine.returnText: Tell {giver} in {town} the medicine was delivered
hermit_medicine.recipientLine: *takes the pouch with shaking hands* Medicine... from {giver}? The fever has had me a week. Thank them for me.
hermit_medicine.handIn: *sighs with relief* Delivered, and in time? You're a good soul.

rival_documents.holderLine: *eyes you coolly* Papers? I keep nothing that concerns you.
rival_documents.handIn: *glances through the pages and smiles thinly* Discreet and effective. My family will remember this.

alt.label: Return the documents to their owner instead (100 gold)
alt.text: You sold {giver}'s scheme back to its target.
alt.grievance: You played me false and took my rival's coin. I shan't forget it.

deliver_challenge.recipientLine: *reads, and flushes red* A challenge? Tell {giver} I accept — and I name the day.
deliver_challenge.handIn: *reads the answer with relish* So the cur accepts. My house's honour will be seen to.

ancient_ruins.handIn: *listens wide-eyed* Just as I dreamed! Here — my share of the finding is yours.

bounty_target.handIn: *counts out the coin* Half the bounty, fair and square. Good hunting.
